thesis: Llanowar Elves established green's one-mana acceleration model: a fragile creature that trades immediate board presence for an extra mana every later turn.

playbook.role: Mulligan and sequence with the turn-two payoff in mind. Protect the Elf only when the accelerated curve is central; otherwise accept that drawing removal away from a larger threat can be useful.
